# Forage United Arab Emirates

> A free guide to wild food in the UAE: which wild plants are in season in each emirate and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 15 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Sidr fruit](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/sidr/): Ziziphus spina-christi; Sidr, Nabq, Christ's thorn jujube. In season November to April.
- [Dates](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/date/): Phoenix dactylifera; Nakhla, Rutab (soft), Tamr (dried). In season June to September.
- [Ghaf leaves and pods](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/ghaf/): Prosopis cineraria; Ghaf, Khejri. In season March to June.
- [Desert truffle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/truffle/): Terfezia and Tirmania species; Faqa', Kama, Fagaa. In season January to April.
- [Bladder dock](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/hummaid/): Rumex vesicarius; Hummaid, Hambaz. In season December to March.
- [Arta fruit](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/arta/): Calligonum comosum; Arta, Abal. In season February to April.
- [Purslane](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/purslane/): Portulaca oleracea; Baqla, Rijla. In season March to November.
- [Wild drumstick tree](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/moringa/): Moringa peregrina; Yasar, Shu'. In season February to May.
- [Capers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/caper/): Capparis spinosa; Kabir. In season March to June.
- [Mallow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/mallowae/): Malva parviflora; Khubbeiza. In season November to April.
- [Nettle-leaved goosefoot](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/goosefoot/): Chenopodium murale; Goosefoot. In season November to April.
- [Green amaranth](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/amaranthae/): Amaranthus viridis; Amaranth. In season April to November.
- [Sow thistle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/sowthistle/): Sonchus oleraceus; Sow thistle. In season November to April.
- [Mesquite pods](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/mesquiteae/): Prosopis juliflora; Mesquite, Ghaf bahri. In season May to August.
- [Arak berries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/arak/): Salvadora persica; Arak, Kabath, Toothbrush tree. In season April to June.
- [Tropical almond](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/tropicalalmond/): Terminalia catappa; Beydam, Indian almond. In season May to November.
- [Mulberries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/plants/mulberryae/): Morus alba; Toot. In season March to May.

## Dishes

- [Mulberry juice](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/mulberry-juice/): Ripe mulberries blended with water and a little sugar, served cold.
- [Moringa leaf tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/moringa-leaf-tea/): Dried drumstick leaves steeped in hot water.
- [Grilled desert truffles](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/grilled-desert-truffles/): Peeled faqa' sliced, brushed with olive oil and grilled, finished with salt and coriander.
- [Hummaid salad](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/hummaid-salad/): Sour bladder dock leaves with tomato, onion and lemon.
- [Purslane fattoush](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/purslane-fattoush/): Toasted bread, purslane, tomato, cucumber and sumac dressing.
- [Pickled capers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/pickled-capers/): Caper buds salted, then kept in vinegar brine.
- [Date syrup (dibs)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/date-syrup/): Dates simmered, pressed and reduced to a dark syrup.
- [Ghaf leaf salad](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/ghaf-leaf-salad/): Finely minced young ghaf leaves mixed with fish and rice.
- [Truffle saloona](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/truffle-saloona/): Emirati tomato-based meat stew with chunks of desert truffle.
- [Khubbeiza (mallow stew)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/khubbeiza/): Mallow leaves sautéed with onion, garlic, olive oil and lemon.
- [Wild greens with eggs](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/wild-greens-with-eggs/): Wilted wild greens cooked with onion and spices, then eggs scrambled in.
- [Mesquite flour flatbread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/mesquite-flour-flatbread/): Part mesquite flour, part wheat flour, cooked on a hot griddle.
- [Luqaimat with date syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/luqaimat-with-date-syrup/): Crisp fried dough balls drizzled with dibs.
- [Fresh rutab](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/fresh-rutab/): Soft, half-ripe summer dates eaten straight from the bunch with Arabic coffee.
- [Sidr fruit snack](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/ae/dishes/sidr-fruit-snack/): Ripe nabq eaten fresh or sun-dried.
